name: Goldsmiths, University of London
description: Goldsmiths is part of the University of London and was founded in 1891. It is located in South East London in New Cross which has a very trendy arts and music scene. Renowned for a creative and innovative approach to teaching and research, Goldsmiths specializes in the arts and humanities, social sciences, computing, and entrepreneurial business and management. In 2017, Goldsmiths' Media and Communications department was named the second best in the UK and 8th worldwide. Ranked #416th according to QS global world ranking 2020-2021. Timestamps
